pages.title: Chunk Loaders
pages.text: Create: Power Loader keeps [#](7A3C9A)[chunks](entry://glossary/chunk)[#]() loaded so machines keep working when you are away. The cost is rotation: a spinning shaft keeps the chunk awake.

pages.title: Empty loaders
pages.text: Empty loaders come dead. Right-click a Ghast with one to capture it. Once powered, the ghasts light the portal cores.

pages.title: Andesite Chunk Loader
pages.text: Loads its own chunk while spun fast enough. Slower rotation means it fails. It gives a comparator signal while active.

pages.title: Brass Chunk Loader
pages.text: Loads 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 chunks. Bigger areas need faster rotation. Set the range on the [#](7A3C9A)[value panel](entry://glossary/value_panel)[#]().

Brass loaders work on moving contraptions (always 3x3, no rotation needed once [#](7A3C9A)[assembled](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]()) and on Train Stations. At a station the area is loaded only while a train is there. See [#](2E5AAC)[Trains](entry://transport/trains)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]().

When power is lost there is a short, [#](7A3C9A)[configurable](entry://glossary/config)[#]() delay before unloading, so brief stalls are fine.\
\
Loaded chunks still [#](7A3C9A)[tick](entry://glossary/tick)[#]() machines, so a big loader grid costs performance.
